title: Ward the Graves
description: The registers told Osric the truth he feared: the old wardens' binding sigils have worn away, and that is why the graves won't hold. He hands you the warding chalk his predecessors used and sends you to re-score the two failing wards — the lych-gate and the crypt porch — while the ghouls that gnaw at the old lines are still few enough to fight. Hold the lines, and buy the village time.

objectives.desc: Re-score the failing ward at the lych-gate
Re-score the failing ward at the crypt porch
Cut down the ghouls gnawing at the binding lines
